# GLIMP TAG forest movement test

The generated scene is intended to be the first playable vertical slice.

## Automatically generated arena
- Central treehouse and branch routes
- Circular raised wooden bridge
- Twelve climbable forest trees with branches and small rest platforms
- Perimeter rock wall with a cave entrance gap
- Short cave tunnel
- Stump gazebo hangout
- Six spawn points for future multiplayer use

## Automatically generated player rig
- Floor-relative XR tracking space
- Center-eye camera pose driver
- Left and right hand proxy transforms
- XR Hands palm pose, with Touch controller fallback
- Rigidbody and capsule body
- Hand-contact movement with correction and velocity limits

## Controls
- Press A or X on a Touch controller to start, or tap the on-screen START RUN button.
- If no controller is available, the sandbox auto-starts after a short delay.
- Move your hands into a surface and continue moving them to push away from it.

## Not included yet
- Multiplayer avatar spawn / network transforms
- Matchmaking or room codes
- Working tag/infection rounds and round reset UI
- Voice chat
- Cosmetics, shop, or account profiles
- Final hand meshes or polished VR menus

This is a test slice scaffold. It has not been compiled, run, or comfort-tested on Quest hardware.
